messages:
lina: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: repeated mid-stream hangups. We need a small, actionable backlog: heartbeat tuning, backpressure signs, resume handshake, and runbook updates. Can we split?

rafael: I'll own heartbeat + backpressure. Plan: send a lightweight ping frame every 7s, add server-side backpressure counter `outstanding_frames`. If outstanding_frames > 3 for 2s, mark stream as congested instead of closing. Spike + tests by Wed.

 dee: I'll take the resume handshake and client retry policy. Proposal: add `Resume-Token` in final frame, clients try resume within 60s with exponential jitter, max 4 attempts. PR by Thu.

oncall-sre: I'll update the runbook: detection queries, immediate mitigation (increase heartbeat to 10s, route to warm pool), and pager thresholds. ETA 48h.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4101: "heartbeat+resume+backpressure". Assignees: rafael, dee, oncall-sre.

rafael: Observability items: histogram `frame_send_delay_ms` and gauge `outstanding_frames`. Alert if p95 frame_send_delay > 1200ms AND partial_count spike.

 dee: Client telemetry: add header `X-Stream-Resume-Attempt` and log `resume_result={ok|fail}`. That will help correlate server logs.

lina: Canary plan: staging 48h, us-east-1 48h. Exit criteria: partial_rate <0.03% and resume_success_rate > 97% across canary windows.

oncall-sre: Pager rule: page if partial_rate > 0.15% for 10m OR resume_fail_rate > 12% for 15m. Otherwise auto-notify the channel.

lina: I'll run a daily 10m sync for the next 5 workdays and track PR/dashboard links here. If anyone gets blocked ping @lina. :white_check_mark:
